orders.text:
WPMS No. 1276 of 2010 
Hon’ble Tarun Agarwala, J.
Shri Sharad Sharma, Senior Advocate 
assisted by Shri Kovid Bhatt, the learned 
counsel for the petitioner. 
Shri Vinay Kumar, Advocate with Shri 
Niranjan Bhatt, the learned counsel for 
respondent No.1. 
Mr. Sudhir Kumar, Brief Holder for 
respondent No.2. 
Learned counsel for the petitioner states 
that relief No. 2 may be deleted. Permission is 
allowed. 
The learned counsel for the petitioner 
may make the necessary endorsement for 
deletion of the prayer during the course of the 
day. 
Admit. 
The controversy involved in the present 
writ petition is with regard to the interpretation 
of the will. 
The learned counsel appearing for 
respondent No.1 will file a counter affidavit 
within three weeks. The learned Brief Holder 
may also file a counter affidavit, if required, 
within the same period. 
List for orders thereafter. 
Issue notice to the respondent No.3 by 
registered post acknowledgment due. Steps to 
be taken within a week. 
Till the next date of listing, the 
petitioner shall not be evicted from the plot in 
question. 
 (Tarun Agarwala, J.) 
Dated 27.07.2010 
Shiv

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPMS No. 1276 of 2010
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
(1) Mr. Prince Chauhan, learned counsel for 
the petitioner. 
(2) Mr. Vinod Nautiyal, learned Deputy 
Advocate General for the State of 
Uttarakhand.
(4) Heard learned counsel for the parties on 
the delay condonation application.
(5) For the facts and reasons indicated in 
the delay condonation application, the same 
(CLMA No. 4168 of 2016) is allowed and 
delay in filing the restoration application is 
hereby condoned.
(6) Also heard on the restoration 
application. 
(7) Subject to payment of cost of ₹5,000/-
by the petitioner to Uttarakhand High Court 
Bar Association Advocates’ Welfare Fund, to 
be deposited within two weeks from today, 
the restoration application (MCC No. 282 of 
2016) will stand allowed.
(8) Let the writ petition be restored to its 
original number along with interim order, if 
any.
(9) List this case on 11.09.2023.
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 
 01.08.2023
Aswal
